# @ndigo/mcp

Model Context Protocol tools projected from Ndigo dispatch metadata

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Capabilities

- `agent-surface` — Expose an application's dispatch handlers as MCP tools over a stdio server. Packages: `@ndigo/mcp`. Guide: `agent-facing-surfaces`.

## Public exports

- `MCPToolDeniedOptions` *(type)* — Options for MCPToolDeniedError.
- `MCPToolDeniedError` — Thrown when a registry policy refuses a tool call. Transports render it as an `isError` tool result, never as a protocol failure.
- `JSONSchema` *(type)* — A JSON Schema object as carried by MCP `tools/list`.
- `ToolDescriptor` *(type)* — The client-facing tool descriptor as reported by `tools/list`.
- `RegisteredTool` *(type)* — A projected tool with the handler needed to invoke it.
- `MappingEntryLike` *(type)* — One `getMappingEntries()` row.
- `MappingTableLike` *(type)* — A mapping table exposing the inspect-style read model.
- `DispatcherLike` *(type)* — A dispatcher-like source: anything carrying handler mapping objects.
- `MappingSource` *(type)* — Anything that can supply mapping entries to the projector.
- `projectTools` — Projects every `@toolMapping` handler in the source into a registered tool.
- `ToolCallContext` *(type)* — Per-call context carried from the transport.
- `MCPToolCall` *(type)* — One tool call under registry policy evaluation.
- `MCPToolRegistryOptions` *(type)* — Policy options for a registry.
- `MCPToolRegistry` — A registry of tools projected from dispatch metadata.
- `MCPServerOptions` *(type)* — Options for createMcpServer.
- `createMcpServer` — Creates an MCP server over a tool registry.
- `startStdioServer` — Starts a server on stdin/stdout. Stdout is reserved for JSON-RPC.
- `MCPHTTPEndpointOptions` *(type)* — Options for MCPHTTPEndpoint.
- `MCPHTTPEndpoint` — A stateless Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint.
- `ProtectedResourceMetadataOptions` *(type)* — Options for protectedResourceMetadata.
- `protectedResourceMetadata` — Builds RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata for an MCP endpoint.
- `MCP_APP_MIME_TYPE` — The MCP Apps HTML resource media type.
- `UIVisibility` *(type)* — Tool visibility inside an MCP App.
- `UICSPConfig` *(type)* — Domains the host adds to the app's Content-Security-Policy.
- `UIMetadata` *(type)* — `_meta.ui` metadata for a tool or resource.
- `UIResource` *(type)* — A `ui://` resource with its self-contained HTML.
- `UIResourceInput` *(type)* — Inputs for createUiResource.
- `createUiResource` — Builds one self-contained MCP App document.
